mods.name: Redstone Books
mods.description:
Cinematic book GUI system for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

Features:
- Animated book opening
- JSON configurable books
- Typewriter text effect
- Voice per page
- Fade transitions
- Reverse animation
- Layout per book

releases.notes:
## ✨ What's New

Redstone Books **v1.2.0** introduces full **dedicated server support**, allowing books to be synchronized between the server and connected clients.

Books are now loaded from the server, ensuring every player always receives the latest version without requiring local JSON files.

## 🚀 Added

- 🌐 Dedicated server support.
- 📡 Server-to-client book synchronization.
- 📚 Server-side book loading.
- 👥 Support for opening books for:
  - Yourself
  - A specific player
  - All connected players (`@a`)

## 🛠 Fixed

- Fixed dedicated server crash caused by client-only classes being loaded on the server.

## 📋 Commands

```text
/redstonebook open <book>
/redstonebook open <book> <player>
/redstonebook open <book> @a
```

## ⚠ Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Forge **47.x**
- Book JSON files must be placed on the **server**:

```text
config/redstonebooks/books/
```

Images, animations and audio continue to be provided through the client resource pack.

---

Thank you for using **Redstone Books**!
